CALLER NOTIFIED THE CANADIAN COAST GUARD EMERGENCY RESPONSE DUTY OFFICER, SPILL ACTION CENTER AND SECTOR DETROIT AND ADVISED ACCORDINGLY. THE AMISHBERG CANADIAN COAST GUARD STAR BASE WAS NOTIFIED AT 1515 UTC WAS ASKED TO SEARCH AND ADVISE OF ANY SIGHTINGS. AT 1530 CAPTAIN OF THE DUNDAR AT THE COAST GUARD BASE REPORTED THAT CREWS WERE ON SCENE AND MAY BE TAKING PICTURES AND SAMPLES OF THE SMALL STREAKING SHEEN THAT IS COMING FROM A PIPE RUN OFF THAT APPEARS TO BELONG TO THE GREAT LAKES STEEL CORPORATION ON THE UNITED STATES SIDE.
